title: Digital history of neuromarketing
descriptions: History of neuromarketing through the collection of online items, archived in a Zotero archive. This project conducted in 2009 recorded all instances of webpages mentioning 'neuromarketing', with a Google search on this term, plus a search on the Lexis Nexis Database.
description: History of neuromarketing through the collection of online items, archived in a Zotero archive. This project conducted in 2009 recorded all instances of webpages mentioning 'neuromarketing', with a Google search on this term, plus a search on the Lexis Nexis Database.
temporal_coverage: From the origins of neuromarketing (2002) to 2008. 2009 is also covered, but not complete.
spatial_coverage: Comprises items in English, Dutch, Flemish,French, German, Spanish

data_sources: The data consists in webpages, newspaper and magazine articles retrieved on the LexisNexis database, all selected because they resulted from a search on a single keyword 'neuromarketing'. These webpages and articles have been saved fully (whole HTML code), plus indexed by a human coder, in a bibliography management software (Zotero). Visuals included in these documents have been indexed in a separate folder in the same Zotero archive.
